name: thumbnail-clone-gpu-probe
description: MEASUREMENT ONLY (TODO 'Open — investigations' lead, 2026-07-18 perf sweep): does `ui/catalog/thumbnails.tsx`'s `GltfThumbnailCapture` (`SkeletonUtils.clone(gltf.scene)` per active def, rendered via `<primitive object={obj}>`) leak geometry/texture GPU resources on unmount, now that the catalog compare tray drives up to 3 concurrent thumbnail requests? Reads `renderer.info.memory.{geometries,textures}` off the THUMBNAIL HOST's own dedicated off-screen `<Canvas>` (NOT the main scene's `window.__three` -- the thumbnail host is a separate R3F root with its own WebGLRenderer) via r3f's internal `_roots` registry (`await import('/node_modules/.vite/deps/@react-three_fiber.js')`, the Vite-optimized-dep URL -- a bare `import('@react-three/fiber')` from page-context eval 404s, it only resolves inside already-bundled app code), identified by its distinctive 256x192 canvas size (`THUMB_W`/`THUMB_H`). Cycles through 3 catalog categories with real bundled GLTF-kind defs (Decor: book-set/ceramic-vase-slim/ceramic-vase-wide/potted-plant-leafy/potted-succulent/standing-photo-frame/tea-set; Lighting: desk-lamp-arm; Tables: 4 pool-table variants) 3 times, forcing 3x re-requests of already-cached AND newly-distinct urls through the single-item queue, then separately drives the compare tray (up to 3 concurrent `useBuiltinThumbnail` calls) with 3 distinct decor defs. Reports geometries/textures before vs after; a leak would show unbounded growth across repeat cycles (revisiting the SAME set of urls should never grow the count once each is cached), a non-leak plateaus after the first pass (first-seen unique urls only).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: define-thumb-gl-getter
steps.eval: (async () => { const fiber = await import('/node_modules/.vite/deps/@react-three_fiber.js'); window.__getThumbGl = () => { for (const [canvas, root] of fiber._roots.entries()) { if (canvas.width === 256 && canvas.height === 192) return root.store.getState().gl; } return null; }; window.__memSnap = () => { const gl = window.__getThumbGl(); if (!gl) return null; return { geometries: gl.info.memory.geometries, textures: gl.info.memory.textures }; }; window.__thumbContextLostCount = 0; window.__thumbContextRestoredCount = 0; const gl0 = window.__getThumbGl(); if (gl0) { gl0.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => { window.__thumbContextLostCount++; }); gl0.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextrestored', () => { window.__thumbContextRestoredCount++; }); } })()

steps.name: assert-thumb-canvas-found
steps.failMessage: could not locate the 256x192 thumbnail host canvas via r3f's _roots registry

steps.name: define-click-category
steps.comment: The category rail is a horizontally-scrollable row -- a tab can be scrolled out of view, and the harness's coordinate-based clickByText can mis-click when that happens (observed while authoring this probe: after several tab switches, a 'Decor' click landed on the wrong tab / a stray match). Click the exact CategoryTabs button via a DOM .click(), scroll-independent.
steps.eval: window.__clickCategory = (label) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().startsWith(label)); if (!b) throw new Error('category tab not found: ' + label + ' -- available chips: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('nav button')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim()).join(', ')); b.click(); }

steps.name: enable-compare-mode
steps.comment: catalogCompare flag (check tier/default) -- force it on directly so the tray is reachable regardless of Simple/Pro mode (this rung is a measurement, not a gate proof).

steps.name: open-compare-mode
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Compare items"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('Compare items button not found -- catalogCompare flag may not be resolving on'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: select-3-decor-items-for-compare
steps.comment: Page 1 of Decor doesn't include the specific generatedCatalog.ts GLTF names (book-set/tea-set/etc land on a later page) -- rather than chasing pagination, just take the first 3 armable cards on whatever page is showing (Decor mixes real bundled GLTF items like 'Floor vase'/'Aquarium'/'Wall mirror' with parametric ones; either way this exercises the compare tray's concurrent useBuiltinThumbnail calls, the actual thing under test).
steps.eval: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-card.compare-armed')]; if (cards.length < 2) throw new Error('expected >=2 compare-armable cards, found ' + cards.length); const picked = cards.slice(0, 3); for (const c of picked) c.click(); window.__comparePicked = picked.length; window.__log.push('compare picks: ' + picked.map(c=>c.textContent.trim().slice(0,30)).join(' | ')); })()

steps.name: open-compare-tray
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Compare' && !x.disabled); if (!b) throw new Error('Compare confirm button not found/disabled'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-compare-tray
steps.failMessage: compare tray modal should mount a CompareColumn per selected def

steps.name: snapshot-after-compare-tray
steps.eval: window.__snap4 = window.__memSnap(); window.__log.push('after compare tray (' + window.__comparePicked + ' concurrent GLTF requests): ' + JSON.stringify(window.__snap4))

steps.name: attempt-gc-pressure
steps.eval: (() => { window.__log.push('window.gc available: ' + (typeof window.gc === 'function')); try { window.gc?.(); } catch {} })()

steps.name: report-context-events
steps.eval: window.__log.push('thumbnail canvas contextlost events: ' + window.__thumbContextLostCount + ', contextrestored events: ' + window.__thumbContextRestoredCount)
